name: Identity & Trust
description: Creates the foundational conditions for relational trust — verified identity, real presence, and data sovereignty.
trustFunction: Creates the conditions for trust to develop. Without verified identity, real presence, and data sovereignty, relational trust has no ground to stand on.

name: Communication
description: Protects and deepens trust through privacy-respecting communication designed for relational depth, not performance or engagement.
trustFunction: Protects trust through privacy and consent; deepens trust through communication modes designed for relational depth rather than performance.

name: Group Formation & Governance
description: Creates the relational container within which trust can develop — collaborative agreements, shared commitments, and slow deliberation.
trustFunction: Creates the container within which trust can develop. The agreements that constitute a group are the behavioral commitments that make relational trust possible.

name: Relationship Development
description: Deepens and repairs trust through the relational practices that move communities from transactional to relational trust.
trustFunction: Deepens and repairs trust through the relational practices that constitute the transition from transactional to relational trust.

name: Co-Creation & Knowledge
description: Deepens trust through collective intelligence — discovering together what no individual could produce alone.
trustFunction: Deepens trust through the experience of collective intelligence — discovering that the group can produce something no individual could have produced alone.

name: Events & Coordination
description: Extends trust from small groups into larger coordination through nested sovereignty, not centralized control.
trustFunction: Extends trust from small groups into larger coordination — proving that relational trust scales through nested sovereignty rather than centralized control.

name: Mutual Aid & Exchange
description: Expresses trust through care — moving from transactional reciprocity to genuine mutuality.
trustFunction: Expresses trust through care — mutual aid is relational trust made tangible. The transition from transactional reciprocity ("I do for you, you do for me") to genuine mutuality ("I care for you, you care for me") is visible here.

name: Learning & Development
description: Develops the human capacities that make trust possible — perspective-taking, vulnerability, repair, and emotional responsiveness.
trustFunction: Develops the human capacities that make trust possible — perspective-taking, vulnerability, repair, emotional responsiveness.

name: Platform Evolution & Sovereignty
description: Ensures the technology itself is trustworthy — community-sovereign infrastructure where AI serves human connection, not surveillance.
trustFunction: Ensures that the technology itself is trustworthy — that communities are sovereign over their own infrastructure, that AI serves human connection rather than surveillance, and that no community is ever locked into a dependency it did not choose.

name: Place-Based Mapping
description: Creates conditions for trust by making visible the shared geography, resources, and challenges that give people concrete reasons to coordinate.
trustFunction: Creates conditions for trust by making visible the shared geography, shared resources, and shared challenges that give people concrete reasons to coordinate. Trust between people deepens when they can see what they share.
